title.value: An Act relating to prohibitions for certain products; creating new provisions; and amending ORS 459.995.
title.provenance: SECTION 1. As used in sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act: 'A Bill For An Act' Relating to prohibitions for certain products; creating new provisions; and amending ORS 459.995.

location.provenance: Be It Enacted by the People of the State of Oregon:

reference.provenance: Sponsored by Senators SOLLMAN, DEMBROW, Representative DEXTER (Presession filed.)

status.provenance: SECTION 1. As used in sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act: 'A Bill For An Act'

pfas_definition.provenance: SECTION 4. A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances. (3) 'Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance' means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
